summary: Enhance your skills with our Occupational Safety and Health Auditing Training Course. Learn essential techniques to ensure workplace safety and compliance.
lede: Safety audit training teaches safety professionals to assess workplace safety systems through structured, evidence-based audits. Participants learn to scope risk-based audit programs, evaluate hazard identification and risk assessment, gather and compare evidence, and report non-conformities with corrective actions. It is designed for auditors, safety managers and compliance staff who need to identify gaps and check whether risk controls are effective.
audienceIntro: This advanced program is structured for professionals responsible for evaluating, maintaining, and improving organizational safety management systems.
modules: OSH Auditing Foundations and ISO Frameworks
Hazard Identification and Risk Assessment Evaluation
Evidence Gathering and Site Assessment Techniques
Evaluating Incident Investigation and Root Cause Analysis
Contractor Safety and Supply Chain Auditing
Audit Reporting, Dashboards, and Strategic Integration
prerequisites: Participants must have a working knowledge of basic occupational safety regulations and prior exposure to safety management systems. Familiarity with ISO 45001 concepts is highly recommended. No advanced data analytics or coding experience is required.
